profile.summary: Kitchen Guard of San Francisco East-Bay is the East Bay location of Kitchen Guard, a company that provides commercial kitchen exhaust and hood cleaning services. Its services include hood cleaning, filter exchange, green steam cleaning and repairs, following NFPA 96 fire-safety standards.
